environment.description: Same Laravel 10 application on PHP-FPM 8.2 in a Kubernetes pod. The pod spec includes a custom annotation referencing a node-level runtime class: 'runtime.kubernetes.io/class: hardened-php'. The cluster uses containerd with a custom OCI runtime hook that loads a profile from /etc/containerd/seccomp/php-restricted.json. This profile is derived from the default Docker seccomp profile but with additional entries in the 'syscalls' array where the 'action' is 'SCMP_ACT_ERRNO' for the following syscall names: execve, execveat, ptrace, process_vm_readv, process_vm_writev. The profile also sets 'defaultAction' to 'SCMP_ACT_ALLOW' so all other syscalls (including read, write, openat, mmap, etc.) proceed normally, allowing PHP-FPM to function. Note: PHP's shell_exec() internally calls fork()+execve(); with execve blocked, the child process receives EPERM and shell_exec() returns null. The application handles this gracefully by returning a 500 error. The pod also has a readOnlyRootFilesystem: false (writable /tmp) and runs as non-root UID 33 (www-data).
